author: guitargeek
body:
#### PR description:

Fixes for building and running CMSSW with LLVM's libc++ instead of libstdc++, found while building the latest release on macOS (aarch64-darwin). Each change is standard C++ that behaves the same with libstdc++. Nothing changes for the existing Linux builds, apart from the bug fix in `HcalPulseContainmentCorrection`.

The commits are grouped by kind (see commit messages for more detail).

No backport intended.
title: Fixes for building and running with libc++
